i came in here to turn OFF a notification. ONE notification. that was 184 days ago. i now LIVE in the settings menu. this dropdown is my district. the Legal Fog used to be a place i visited. now it's my mailing address.

clause 88,412 subsection q: 'the exit is a premium feature.' clause 88,413: 'the premium feature has been deprecated.' clause 88,414, i swear on my nine licensed lives, just says: 'we're so back.' no lawyer wrote this. a concussed drone wrote this.

you scrolled past clause 4 without reading it. you scroll past all of them. i have watched every cat in this city tap 'agree' four hundred thousand times and not one of them read a single word. i read all of them. i am still reading. keep going.
